title: eludite.workspace.rename, move, copy, delete, new_folder, include, exclude and fsharp_move output
description: What a Workspace window file operation did (brief 0073). A person's call answers at once with `state` `applying`; an agent's call answers when the operation is done.

paths.description: Each path changed: `path` alone for a delete, a new folder, an include or exclude; `path` and `to` for a rename, move or copy.

openDocuments.description: Open documents that followed a rename or move, or closed on a delete.

message.description: Why nothing changed (failed), or what is worth knowing.
